name: uncounterable_veil_of_summer
note: Veil of Summer: 'Spells you control can't be countered this turn.' A one-shot effect lasting the turn that changes the rules, so it covers a spell cast after it resolved (CR 611.2c). P0 casts the Veil (P1 passes with Convolute in hand), then a Centaur Courser; P1 counters with Convolute, which resolves without countering it. No opponent cast a blue or black spell before the Veil, so it draws nothing ('Draw a card if an opponent has cast a blue or black spell this turn.'). Red on main dd4ba95: neither sentence parsed, so the Courser was countered. Converted 2026-11-11 to real priority (docs/DESIGN_PRIORITY.md): the response window is gone, so the answer is a spell cast while the first waits on the stack ("hold").
